remarks: Nestled in the peaceful surroundings of North Stamford, this inviting property offers the perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and lifestyle. Set on expansive, beautifully maintained land, the home features its own private tennis court, a large in-ground pool, and a relaxing hot tub-ideal for both entertaining and unwinding.  Inside, the home exudes a serene and welcoming atmosphere with three spacious bedrooms and three full baths. A dedicated home office provides the perfect space for remote work, while a fully equipped home gym supports a healthy, active lifestyle. The cozy family room with a fireplace creates a warm gathering place, and the three-season sunroom offers a tranquil setting to enjoy the natural surroundings year-round.  Additional highlights include a full-house generator for peace of mind and thoughtfully designed spaces that balance functionality with comfort. This is a rare opportunity to own a private retreat with exceptional amenities-come make this beautiful home yours today.
